definitions.explanation: Formal examination and discussion of a matter, typically in legislative, judicial, or committee settings.

examples.japanese: {法案|ほうあん}を{審議|しんぎ}する。
{委員会|いいんかい}で{予算|よさん}の{審議|しんぎ}が{行|おこな}われた。
examples.english: The budget was deliberated in committee.

examples.japanese: この{問題|もんだい}については、{慎重|しんちょう}な{審議|しんぎ}が{必要|ひつよう}だと{考|かんが}えます。
examples.english: I believe careful deliberation is needed on this issue.

notes:
A formal word used mainly in legislative, judicial, and administrative contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {審議|しんぎ}する: to deliberate
- {審議|しんぎ}に{入|はい}る: to enter deliberation
- {審議|しんぎ}{中|ちゅう}: under deliberation
- {審議|しんぎ}を{尽|つ}くす: to deliberate thoroughly
- {審議|しんぎ}{会|かい}: deliberation council

HOMOPHONE:
{真偽|しんぎ} (truth or falsehood) is pronounced the same but has a completely different meaning.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {審議|しんぎ}: formal deliberation (legislature, committee)
- {議論|ぎろん}: discussion, debate (general)
- {検討|けんとう}: examination, consideration (less formal)
